record.original_question: For non-symmetric tensors in V⊗d, each choice of contracted d-1 factors defines an eigenscheme, and the eigencompatibility variety EC_{n,d} records d-tuples of schemes that can simultaneously occur from one tensor. Determine the dimension and defining equations of EC_{n,d}.

evidence.quote: Problem 11. Determine dimension and equations for ECn,d .

The eigencompatibility variety, introduced in [ASS17], records the d-tuples of schemes which can be eigenschemes of a tensor T : ECn,d = {(X1 , . . . , Xd ) ∈ (PV )·Dn,d × · · · × (PV )·Dn,d : there exists T ∈ V ⊗d with Xi = XiT };

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $V$ be a complex vector space of dimension $n$, and let $d \geq 2$. For a tensor $T \in V^{\otimes d}$ and each index $i \in \{1,\dots,d\}$, contracting $T$ in the $d-1$ factors other than the $i$-th with a vector $v \in V$ defines a multilinear map whose fixed points (up to scalar) give a zero-dimensional subscheme $X_i^T \subset \mathbb{P}V$, called the $i$-th eigenscheme of $T$. For generic $T$, each $X_i^T$ has a fixed length $D_{n,d}$ depending only on $n$ and $d$. Let $\mathrm{Hilb}^{D_{n,d}}(\mathbb{P}V)$ denote the Hilbert scheme of length-$D_{n,d}$ subschemes of $\mathbb{P}V$. Define the eigencompatibility variety
$$\mathrm{EC}_{n,d} = \overline{\{(X_1,\dots,X_d) \in \mathrm{Hilb}^{D_{n,d}}(\mathbb{P}V)^{\times d} : \exists\, T \in V^{\otimes d} \text{ with } X_i = X_i^T \text{ for all } i\}}.$$
Determine the dimension of $\mathrm{EC}_{n,d}$ and a system of defining equations for $\mathrm{EC}_{n,d}$ inside $\mathrm{Hilb}^{D_{n,d}}(\mathbb{P}V)^{\times d}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The eigencompatibility variety was introduced by Abo–Seigal–Sturmfels (2017) for the symmetric case, and the non-symmetric version is posed as an open problem in recent tensor-geometry literature. A web search did not surface any paper computing the dimension or defining equations of $\mathrm{EC}_{n,d}$ in the non-symmetric setting, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Schemes Associated with Eigenvectors of Tensors
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses eigenschemes of tensors but does not provide dimension or equations for the non-symmetric eigencompatibility variety EC_{n,d}.
status_evidence.claim: No known determination of dim/equations of EC_{n,d} in the non-symmetric case.

status_evidence.title: On Waring Rank Jumps via critical rank-one approximations
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on critical rank-one approximations (eigenvectors) of tensors that does not resolve eigencompatibility variety equations.
status_evidence.claim: Related recent work does not solve the problem.
